inputIndex.description: Position of this URL in the input urls array, starting at 0. Rows arrive in completion order; use this to line them up with the input.

url.description: The URL exactly as given in the input.

resolvedUrl.description: The direct download URL actually fetched (share links and arXiv /abs/ pages resolved). Empty if the URL was rejected before download.

fileName.description: File name from the resolved URL path.

status.description: ok = text returned (charged). no_text = valid PDF with no readable text (free). failed = could not download or open (free).

subStatus.description: Machine-readable reason. ok: text_layer, ocr, ocr_incomplete, budget_incomplete (a very long PDF stopped early; see notes). no_text: no_text_layer, scanned_ocr_off, ocr_found_nothing. failed: http_<code>, not_a_pdf, too_large, download_timeout, download_error, password_required, wrong_password, unsupported_encryption, corrupt_pdf, empty_document, bad_page_range, page_range_out_of_bounds, invalid_url, cost_limit_reached, free_work_limit, extraction_error.

error.description: Human-readable explanation when status is not ok; empty string otherwise.

pagesExtracted.description: Pages read (all pages, or those selected by pageRange).

ocrPages.description: Pages whose text came from OCR. Each is one ocr-page charge.

scannedPages.description: Pages with no text layer that contain an image, i.e. OCR candidates.

text.description: Full extracted text. Line breaks kept; pages joined by a blank line.

textTruncated.description: True when the row was too big for a dataset item: text holds the first 1,000,000 characters and the full text is at fullTextUrl.

fullTextUrl.description: Link to the full text in the run key-value store when textTruncated is true; empty otherwise.

pages.description: Per-page text when includePages is on: {pageNumber, text, charCount, ocr}. Empty array otherwise.

chunks.description: RAG chunks when chunkSize > 0: {index, text, pageStart, pageEnd, charCount}. Empty array otherwise.

title.description: PDF metadata title; empty if absent.

author.description: PDF metadata author; empty if absent.

subject.description: PDF metadata subject; empty if absent.

keywords.description: PDF metadata keywords; empty if absent.

creator.description: Application that created the original document.

creationDate.description: Creation date as ISO 8601 when parseable; empty if absent.

modDate.description: Modification date as ISO 8601 when parseable; empty if absent.

pdfVersion.description: PDF version x10 (15 = PDF 1.5); 0 when unknown.

isEncrypted.description: True if the PDF uses encryption (including owner-password restrictions that open without a password).

notes.description: Warnings that do not fail the row, e.g. scanned pages skipped by the OCR cap.

processingMs.description: Time spent downloading and extracting this PDF, excluding queueing.
